case: microstrip notch filter, shunt open stub, |S11| peak
note: The shunt open stub reflects at its quarter-wave resonance, so the notch is the |S11| maximum and the |S21| minimum; the earlier study searched for a |S11| minimum and is superseded. Self-convergence of a graded 3-D model; the quarter-wave estimate neglects the open-end extension, so it is a check of the order of magnitude, not an oracle.
